## Cluster proportions


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
metadata_full_df <-
  as_tibble(so_full@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
  select(cell, general_cell_types, mouse)
metadata_T_df <- as_tibble(so_T@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
  select(cell, clusters_T, general_T_subtypes)
metadata_M_df <- as_tibble(so_M@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
  select(cell, clusters_M, general_M_subtypes)

metadata_df <- metadata_full_df %>%
  left_join(metadata_T_df, by = "cell") %>%
  left_join(metadata_M_df, by = "cell")
```
:::


### Not split by mouse


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
prop_df <- metadata_df %>%
  mutate(subcluster = ifelse(
    is.na(clusters_T),
    as.character(clusters_M),
    as.character(clusters_T)
  )) %>%
  group_by(general_cell_types, subcluster) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    subcluster = case_when(
      general_cell_types == "Myeloid" & is.na(subcluster) ~ "doublets",
      general_cell_types == "T/NK" &
        is.na(subcluster) ~ "doublets",
      TRUE ~ subcluster
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(proportion_of_all = n / sum(n)) %>%
  group_by(general_cell_types) %>%
  mutate(proportion_of_general_cell_type = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}
```
`summarise()` has grouped output by 'general_cell_types'. You can override
using the `.groups` argument.
```
:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(prop_df, file.path(results_dir, "cluster_proportions_for_Brian.csv"))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

    is.na(clusters_T),
    as.character(clusters_M),
    as.character(clusters_T)
  )) %>%
```

# Cluster & genotype proprotions


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
metadata_full_df <- as_tibble(so_full@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
    select(cell, general_cell_types, genotype, treatment)
metadata_T_df <- as_tibble(so_T@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
    select(cell, clusters_T, general_T_subtypes)
metadata_M_df <- as_tibble(so_M@meta.data, rownames = "cell") %>%
    select(cell, clusters_M, general_M_subtypes)

metadata_df <- metadata_full_df %>%
    left_join(metadata_T_df, by = "cell") %>%
    left_join(metadata_M_df, by = "cell")

genotype_prop_df <- metadata_df %>%
    mutate(subcluster = ifelse(
        is.na(clusters_T),
        as.character(clusters_M),
        as.character(clusters_T)
    )) %>%
    group_by(general_cell_types, subcluster, genotype, treatment) %>%
    summarise(n = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
        subcluster = case_when(
            general_cell_types == "Myeloid" & is.na(subcluster) ~ "doublets",
            general_cell_types == "T/NK" &
                is.na(subcluster) ~ "doublets",
            TRUE ~ subcluster
        )
    ) %>%
    group_by(general_cell_types, subcluster) %>%
    mutate(proportion_of_subcluster = n / sum(n)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(general_cell_types, subcluster),
        names_from = c(genotype, treatment),
        values_from = c(n, proportion_of_subcluster)
    )
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}
```
`summarise()` has grouped output by 'general_cell_types', 'subcluster',
'genotype'. You can override using the `.groups` argument.
```
:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
prop_df %>%
    left_join(genotype_prop_df, by = c("general_cell_types", "subcluster")) %>%
    write_csv(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_proportions_for_Brian_with_genotypes.csv"))
```
